What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Stardust]]: left, the image of [[Stardust (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 6489b69); right, the image of [[Stardust (Errata 3)]] (holotable commit a48c2e8). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/stardust.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a48c2e81cc3088f72a385f3f4d68256d8012369f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/stardust.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
